name: Jackson County, IL
findings: Jackson County has 213 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jackson County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Jackson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
